title: Abyssal Bite does not regain its printed go-again action point when catalog places the keyword inline

printed_evidence.functional_text_plain:
You may play this from your banished zone.
Your next Shadow attack this turn gets +1{p}. Go again

printed_evidence.expected_rule: Ordinary cost1 Action consumes1AP and its unconditional own go again restores1AP after resolution. Printed face has separate Go again paragraph; no suppression/card/hero ability removes it in this empty four-live fixture.

static_cause: FaBPrintedKeywordIsActive requires the entire trimmed newline-delimited line to equal Go again. Cache puts unconditional own keyword after nextShadowattack sentence on same line, so detector returns false despite card_keywords containing Go again. Plain-spell resolution uses detector for AP refund. Broad matching could confuse grants to other cards with own keyword; no global parser change or card override applied.
